correctness.rationale: Independently reduced the exact translated μ=32 field to RESULT.md (4). The sign of -h(32s-25) forces radial monotonicity off the invariant levels; each positive trajectory in s<4 stays inside a compact disk of radius at most max(√s(0),1)<2 with xy bounded below. This proves forward completeness and attraction to the appropriate radial endpoint, except for the stationary center and ring. At s=a=9/16 or 1 the angular speed magnitude is 14εw, so one turn gives the minimal period. In (6), q²=(2-√(4-a))/(2+√(4-a)); the quarter-turn Fourier correlation is (1-q⁴)/(1+q⁴)=4√(4-a)/(8-a). Thus the periods are as stated. The scalar normal variational rate is -196aw; integrating w dt over one turn gives π/(7ε), hence log ρ=-28πa/ε. For the exit law set A=-128wsh so that s-dot=A(s,θ)(s-s*). A is strictly positive with a uniform lower bound on the full compact collar for every fixed η<7/32. The exact quotient dθ/ds=-ε/(2sh) is bounded there, so the angular displacement is Oη,ε(|s-s*|+|δ|), uniformly in phase. With A*=1225w*(φ)/16, the difference of reciprocal speed factors 1/A and 1/A* is consequently Oη,ε(|s-s*|+|δ|). Integrating after dividing by |s-s*| gives the claimed logarithmic delay with uniform bounded remainder on both sides, not just a linearization heuristic. The area fractions follow by radial area. The supplied script and verification notes were inspected, not executed; the script samples only the outward side of the exit law. No outside-disk or ε=0 claim is supported.

value.rationale: The originating paper highlights μ=32 as the symmetric two-cycle case, making it a natural regime rather than an arbitrary specialization. The exact basin split and especially the uniform escape coefficient give a physically measurable distinction: states with identical radial displacement can have different leading residence times. Dividing out xy would preserve the phase portrait but lose this distinction and alter the periods; the explicit clocks are useful when comparing physical-time trajectories in a bistable model. The area fraction or the existence of stable cycles alone would not support the value decision.
